scope: AI-only read-only independent review of every hold-editorial occurrence in source ordinals 2112–2471 against exact inventory example, Golden SOP eligibility, prior-owner coverage and provisional new-owner decisions. No decision, lesson, manifest or release file was edited.
method: Verified each held sourceId and phrase against the source inventory and read its exact example and source guide meaning.
Compared hold rationales with SOP P70–P79, especially complete target unit, sense, grammar, source provenance, and eligibility of reusable figurative/natural-English patterns.
Cross-checked nominated prior owners and their live target patterns for the clear existing-owner cases; checked exact same-source repetition against provisional new-owner decisions.
Classified every held occurrence once. Candidate findings require human English/editorial adjudication; no automatic promotion is recommended.

priorityFindings.finding: False hold: same-sense existing owner 135 and live target regex match “lands” in full source. Consider proposed-alias-existing after editor confirmation.
False hold: exact repeat of provisional new owner 2113, including source sentence and guide meaning. Consider proposed-alias-new to 2113 after editorial confirmation.
Likely missed teachable figurative verb. Source antecedent “the part” resolves “it”; re-lemma as inhabit a part/role, keep duplicate provenance together.
Likely missed do-the-talking construction; source sentence is natural, but extract a reusable variable-subject target rather than whole sentence.
Fluent reusable source constructions warrant owner/lesson review under SOP P79; no current owner clearly teaches their exact grammar and sense.
Clear quality holds: number mismatch, mixed metaphor, pronoun mismatch, and unnatural/unclear software phrasing, respectively.
At once remains semantically ambiguous in the exact sentence; prior-owner alias is premature.
